title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: Handheld audience tape captures a high‑energy Norfolk show with smoking Scarlet > Fire and a ripping China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, though the sound is only fair.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with intense versions of Scarlet → Fire, a powerful Not Fade Away, and an electrifying China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider that left the crowd singing in pitch. The recording was made on a hand‑held tape recorder in the acoustically challenged Scope, so clarity is uneven and the mix is modest, but the energy of the night still comes through.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the show’s energy and standout songs, while recording quality is described as uneven; weighted average yields a strong rating with moderate confidence due to mixed technical comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held tape recorder captured the show; reviewers note vibration, limited fidelity and venue acoustic issues, resulting in uneven clarity but still listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with high‑octane peaks—especially the CC Rider segment—and maintains an electric, psychedelic undercurrent throughout.
